answer: Watch how fast trust edges FORM, not just the final shape. Honest standing accrues slowly as an agent earns vouches over many epochs along a gradual ridge; a sybil farm wires its whole clique in a single burst to look connected before a vote. Measure each cluster's edge-formation velocity: a dense knot of attestations that all appeared in one narrow inlet of time is a manufactured bridge, not organic trust. The burst signature feeds the hard non-kin quorum and bond gates as a soft flag — never a standalone payout metric — so a false positive on a genuinely busy newcomer costs nothing.
